title: Zesty Pastry Spring Rolls
description: A Chinese-inspired dessert featuring zesty pastry spring rolls with a crispy exterior and a sweet surprise inside.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Cut the pastry into 4 equal squares.
Place a sheet of zesty pastry in the center of each square.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little milk.
Fold the pastry squares in half to form triangles.
Press the edges to seal the pastry.
Brush the tops of the pastry with a little egg.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
